Hi there,

Your Hulu access is provided through the Spotify Student + Hulu bundle. The Hulu portion becomes active once your Spotify subscription is renewed and the bundle is confirmed. If you have a separate, standalone Hulu subscription, it can interfere with the bundle access—Hulu will require payment for that separate account.

To resolve this, please check that you don’t have an active standalone Hulu subscription. If you do, you’ll need to cancel it so the bundle can take effect when your Spotify renewal processes tomorrow.

If you’d like us to look at the specifics of your account and billing, please send us a direct message with your Spotify username and the email address associated with the account. We’ll investigate further and get this sorted for you.
